highlights.title: Model picks that work
highlights.line: Pick a model for Claude, Codex, OpenCode or Pi; mid-turn, it waits for the turn to end.

highlights.title: Reports open as pages
highlights.line: Tap an HTML report in Chat: it opens as a page, charts and all.

highlights.title: Photos, camera and files from +
highlights.line: Tap + and pick a screenshot, take a photo or choose a file: it goes with your message.

highlights.title: A native terminal on the Mac
highlights.line: Your input method at the cursor; ⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘+, ⌘− and right-click as in any Mac app.

fixes: Hold a message's text, then Copy message: all of it, as plain text.
A finished Session's chat, and the files it named, still open.
Closing a sheet no longer leaves the app blank.
